description: Create PopularProductsActivity (layout + Kotlin file), register it in AndroidManifest.xml, and update HomeActivity.kt to navigate to it when 'View All Products' is tapped. This FEAT depends on FEAT-001 (the button ids already exist in the layout after FEAT-001). It is the only file-creation step that introduces a new Activity.
steps:
1. CREATE app/src/main/res/layout/activity_popular_products.xml. Base structure on activity_category_products.xml but without search/filter. Full structure:
   Root: androidx.coordinatorlayout.widget.CoordinatorLayout, background=@color/bg_screen, fitsSystemWindows=true
   Child 1: LinearLayout vertical, paddingBottom=80dp, layout_height=match_parent, layout_width=match_parent:
     Child 1.1: LinearLayout horizontal, layout_height=56dp, gravity=center_vertical, paddingHorizontal=16dp:
       - ImageButton id=btnBack, 40dp x 40dp, background=@drawable/bg_back_button, src=@drawable/ic_arrow_back, padding=10dp, contentDescription='Back'
       - TextView id=tvTitle, layout_width=0dp, layout_weight=1, text='Popular Products', textColor=@color/white, textSize=18sp, textStyle=bold, gravity=center
       - FrameLayout id=btnCartTop, 40dp x 40dp, background=@drawable/bg_icon_circle:
           ImageView 20dp x 20dp, layout_gravity=center, src=@drawable/ic_cart
           TextView id=tvCartBadge, 16dp x 16dp, layout_gravity=top|end, layout_margin=2dp, background=@drawable/bg_badge, textColor=@color/white, textSize=9sp, gravity=center, textStyle=bold, visibility=gone
     Child 1.2: FrameLayout, layout_width=match_parent, layout_height=0dp, layout_weight=1:
       - ProgressBar id=progressBar, layout_width=wrap_content, layout_height=wrap_content, layout_gravity=center, visibility=gone, indeterminate=true
       - RecyclerView id=rvProducts, match_parent x match_parent, paddingHorizontal=10dp, clipToPadding=false, overScrollMode=never, scrollbars=none, visibility=gone
       - LinearLayout id=emptyState, match_parent x match_parent, orientation=vertical, gravity=center, padding=32dp, visibility=gone:
           ImageView 64dp x 64dp, src=@drawable/ic_search, alpha=0.25, contentDescription='No products'
           TextView id=tvEmptyTitle, text='No products found', textColor=@color/white, textSize=16sp, textStyle=bold, layout_marginTop=16dp
           TextView id=tvEmptySubtitle, text='Check back soon for new arrivals', textColor=@color/text_secondary, textSize=13sp, gravity=center, layout_marginTop=8dp
   Child 2: include layout=@layout/layout_bottom_nav, id=bottomNav, 72dp height, layout_gravity=bottom

3. MODIFY app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml: add inside <application>, directly after the .HomeActivity entry:
   <activity android:name='.PopularProductsActivity' android:exported='false'
       android:screenOrientation='portrait'
       android:theme='@style/Theme.HookahDrop.Main'/>

4. MODIFY app/src/main/java/com/hookahdrop/app/HomeActivity.kt: in setupProductGrid(), change the setOnClickListener for b.btnViewAllProducts from calling goToCategories() to:
   startActivity(Intent(this, PopularProductsActivity::class.java))
   overridePendingTransition(R.anim.nav_enter, R.anim.nav_exit)
   Ensure the Intent import is already present (it is) and PopularProductsActivity is in the same package so no extra import is needed.
5. Build: run .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug from the HookahDrop directory. Expect BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

HomeActivity.kt btnViewAllProducts click handler starts PopularProductsActivity (not CategoriesActivity)
